name: app-6a8d368846b08191acb264e97a9d1ac2
description: UK private-company intelligence: search, size and qualify UK companies on charges, ownership, property and modelled financials.

interface.longDescription:
Find UK companies that fit a credit box, an acquisition brief or a target list, and qualify them before anyone calls.

Companies House lets you filter its register by name, status, type, location, SIC code and incorporation date. It cannot filter by charge holder, director or shareholder age, property ownership, or turnover. Zorro can, across the whole index rather than a ranked sample.

Filters include registered charges, the lenders holding them and satisfaction status; ownership chains resolved to the ultimate owner, so one filter returns everything an owner controls; corporate shareholders; director and shareholder (PSC) age from Companies House date-of-birth data, either one officer or the whole board; registered land in England and Wales from HM Land Registry, with title count and freehold or leasehold tenure; share allotments, employees, SIC code and turnover.

Turnover and profit for private UK companies are modelled estimates, not filed accounts, because most UK companies never file a profit and loss. Zorro reports coverage per field, with its source, so you can see what share of a filtered set actually holds a value before relying on it.

Limits, up front. UK only. Registered charges are a floor: unsecured lending never files. Property covers England and Wales only. There is no FCA register integration, so regulated status is never asserted. Contact enrichment quotes its credit cost before it runs. No outreach is sent from this connector: campaign enrolment and sending stay in the Zorro app behind human approval.
